WITH filtered_reviews AS (
  SELECT r.review_id, CAST(r.review_creation_date AS DATE) AS review_date
  FROM reviews.order_reviews AS r
  JOIN orders.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
  JOIN orders.products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes'
    AND r.review_creation_date IS NOT NULL
),
daily_counts AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN review_date >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND review_date < DATE '2018-02-01' THEN 'window'
      WHEN review_date >= DATE '2017-12-01' AND review_date < DATE '2018-01-01' THEN 'baseline'
    END AS period,
    review_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT review_id) AS daily_reviews
  FROM filtered_reviews
  WHERE (review_date >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND review_date < DATE '2018-02-01')
     OR (review_date >= DATE '2017-12-01' AND review_date < DATE '2018-01-01')
  GROUP BY period, review_date
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN daily_reviews END)::DOUBLE, 4) AS value,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN daily_reviews END)::DOUBLE, 4) AS baseline,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN 1 END) AS window_days,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN 1 END) AS baseline_days
FROM daily_counts;
